title.context: Budget tab: heading of the review of a finished month; {month} is the month name alone.

spentOver.context: Month review: total spending against the total limits, over.

spentUnder.context: Month review: total spending against the total limits, under.

spent.context: Month review: total spending when there were no limits.

leftOverPlanned.message: Left over {amount}, against {planned} planned for savings.
leftOverPlanned.context: Month review: income minus spending, compared with what the plan meant to save.

short.context: Month review: spending was more than income by {amount}.

shortPlanned.message: Short by {amount}, against {planned} planned for savings.
shortPlanned.context: Month review: spending exceeded income, while the plan meant to save {planned}.

wentOver.context: Month review: heading of the categories that ended over their limit.

overBy.context: Month review: a category's overshoot, e.g. '120 zł over 800 zł'.

leftRoom.context: Month review: heading of the categories that ended well under their limit.

unused.context: Month review: how much of a category's limit went unused.

planWithIt.context: Month review: button that opens the planner for the current month using the review.

seeAll.context: Month review: button that switches to the finished month; {month} is the name alone.
